author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
You know you are doing real engineering work if you reach the flow state. Whether you are writing code by hand in the good old days, or chatting with your favorite AI vibe coding, you can reach the flow state.

In the flow state, you hold the whole complex problem in your mind, you are fully aware of how the pieces interact with each other.  Whether you edit the code by typing or command AI to vibe code it for you, it is essentially the same kind of mental workout, only at a different the level of abstraction.

Welcome to the new world.
